Fact: training_method
What to find: Main stages and methods of training (pretraining, SFT, preference optimisation/DPO, RL, distillation, merging).
Card sections that often contain it: Training, Training Procedure, Post-training

Answer with status, value, quote and section.

answer.value: Pre-trained on Dolma 3, then post-trained in three stages: Stage 1 SFT, Stage 2 DPO (direct preference optimization), Stage 3 RLVR (reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards), on Dolci datasets.
answer.quote:
#### Stage 3: RLVR
- reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards on the Dolci-Think-RL-7B dataset. This dataset consits of math, code, instruction-following, and general chat queries.
